findings.rationale: tg.wait() blocks indefinitely. timeout_seconds parameter explicitly suppressed with (void)timeout_seconds at line 64. Comment at line 62 states 'blocks indefinitely if tasks hang'. No enforcement mechanism. Direct hang vector if morsel task stalls.

loop_thread_.join() with no timeout or deadline guard in destructor path. If the loop thread is stuck in a spin or blocked I/O, the destructor hangs indefinitely — a liveness failure in streaming engine teardown.

Inline tg.wait() at line 4872; comment acknowledges 'timeout is advisory post-fact (no cancellation)'. Post-hoc telemetry exists but no pre-emptive interrupt. Downgraded: observational wrapper still detects overruns and logs audit events — not a silent hang.

tg.wait() inside tbbWaitWithTimeout() helper. Timeout measured POST-FACT (lines 94-108): elapsed compared after wait returns, audit event logged. No pre-emptive cancellation signal to tasks — timeout cannot interrupt a hung worker. Real risk but diagnostic coverage exists.

Explicit TODO comment: 'Implement asynchronous cleanup for dependency index removals'. Current code performs synchronous cleanup inline under the cache lock — creates lock contention on eviction paths. Not a crash/safety issue; a performance debt for Phase N+1.

catch(...) swallows unknown exceptions in JIT specialisation path with RATIONALE comment. Intentional design decision but masks unknown error types that could silently corrupt compiler state; no rethrow or structured escalation. Warrants a typed catch or explicit panic.

Source shows defensive check: 'if (!input.data() || input.empty())' at line 238 before morsel processing. However, check is inside TBB lambda — the outer call site at line 225 (sequentialScan) does NOT have an equivalent guard. Potential null on the sequential fallback path.

Source scan finds 25 anonymous namespace blocks inside 65 'namespace themis' scopes. The scanner flags any identifier in an anonymous namespace as a scope_mismatch with outer namespace identifiers — this is standard C++ practice (anonymous namespace = translation-unit-local linkage). Not an actual scope ambiguity in production code. All 3863 instances are false positives of this pattern.

Two remaining braces_imbalance gaps reported at line 1 — scanner artifact from counting braces before reaching any actual code. All 12 real brace imbalances were fixed in the Brace Resolution batch (2026-08-16). Line 1 triggers are a scanner initialization artifact, not a code defect.
